forces: Governance verdicts must be reproducible from committed bytes and Git history alone, independent of actor and wall clock.
Absent, corrupt, or incomplete evidence must deny rather than read as nothing-to-check.
Ordering, provenance, and activation must bind exact Git objects that no party to the change can rewrite.
A candidate version of the checker must not be the sole judge of whether it weakened itself.
The rule system has one owner in one repository and no independently variable rule provider.

approach-composed-specifications.reason: Specification answers a variation force that is not present here: there is no independently owned or runtime-selected family of predicates, and no second rule provider to compose against. It would add participant and lifecycle concepts without improving deterministic evidence, baseline trust, or exact Git binding, and its combinator tree would put a layer of indirection between a failing control and the named diagnostic a mutation test has to demand.
